text: A report on the problem of Nineveh, the way God gave Nahum of Elkosh to see it:
He won't be trifled with. He avenges his foes. He stands up against his enemies, fierce and raging.

He's powerful, but it's a patient power. Still, no one gets by with anything. Sooner or later, everyone pays. Tornadoes and hurricanes are the wake of his passage, Storm clouds are the dust he shakes off his feet.
All the rivers run dry. The Bashan and Carmel mountains shrivel, the Lebanon orchards shrivel.
hills dissolve into mud flats. Earth shakes in fear of God. The whole world's in a panic.
Who can stand up to this fierce rage? His anger spills out like a river of lava, his fury shatters boulders.
